title: A ZeroBounce-valid email at another company is the wrong person
hypothesis: A valid verifier status means the right contact.
change: Checked each found email's domain against the brand and parent domains, retrying the runner-up when off-domain.
result: Gymshark's search returned a Social Media Ambassador whose email was at buckedup.com, and ZeroBounce called it valid. With the domain check and one runner-up retry, Gymshark, Celsius and Barebells all ended on valid on-domain buyers.
next_decision: Keep the domain check in the chain; this is the Zeutara mismatch lesson found again by hand.
check: Run `chewbacca gtme lesson verified-email` on every found email before spending on outreach.
scope: Brand contacts found by people search plus Findymail.
